issues.description: The problem statement (both the descriptive task and the UML) specifies a method addGuestStudents(int, String) that accepts a number of new guest students and a reason string, but the solution implementation provides addGuestStudents(int) with only a single int parameter. The template contains a TODO for this method but does not define the required two-parameter signature. This parameter mismatch between specification and solution will confuse students and cause compilation/signature differences against expected tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signature consistent across artifacts. Either (A) change the solution and template to implement the two-parameter signature: public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, String reason) and update the guest student count (e.g., this.numberOfGuestStudents += numberOfNewGuestStudents) while optionally handling or logging the reason; or (B) if the reason parameter is intentionally unnecessary, update the problem statement and UML to specify addGuestStudents(int) only. Ensure all three places (problem statement/UML, template, and solution) use the same parameter list.
